positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Co-founder at Pronestia. I handle the parts you actually look at — the UI, the UX, and all the little details that make software feel less like a chore.
We're building a project management platform for construction teams who've made peace with spreadsheets but secretly want better. My job is to make sure that when they switch, they don't miss the spreadsheet.
